ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن أبي موسى الأشعري رضي الله عنه قال: سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رجلا يُثني على رجل ويُطريه في المدحة، فقال: "أهلكتم، أو قطعتم ظهر الرجل" (23).

tr.diyanet_full_text: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah şöyle buyurmuştur: Kendisine reyhan kokusu ikram edilen kimse, onu reddetmesin; çünkü o hem hafiftir, hem de kokusu güzeldir.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ebû Mûsâ el-Eş‘arî radıyallahu anh şöyle demiştir: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem bir adamın bir kimseyi övdüğünü ve övgüde aşırıya gittiğini işitti. Bunun üzerine: “Onu helâk ettiniz yahut adamın belini kırdınız” buyurdu.

en.sunnah_full_text: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) heard a person lauding another person or praising him too much. Thereupon he said, "You killed the man," or he said, "You ruined the man.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Abu Musa al-Ash‘ari (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) heard a man praising another man and exaggerating in praise of him. He said: “You have destroyed him, or you have cut the man’s back.”
en.narrator: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن أبي بكر رضي الله عنه أن رجلا ذُكر عند النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فأثنى عليه رجل خيرًا، فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم : "ويحك! قطعت عنق صاحبك" يقوله مرارًا "وإن كان أحدكم مادحًا لا محالة، فليقل: أحسب كذا وكذا إن كان يرى أنه كذلك وحسيبه الله، ولا يزكي على الله أحدًا"

tr.diyanet_full_text: Enes’ten (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre o, şöyle demiştir: Peygamberimiz , (kendisine sunulan) güzel kokuyu reddetmezdi.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ebû Bekir radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in yanında bir adamdan söz edildi; başka bir adam onu hayırla övdü. Bunun üzerine Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Yazık sana! Arkadaşının boynunu kopardın.” Bunu birkaç kez söyledi. “Sizden biri mutlaka övecekse, onda böyle olduğunu görüyorsa: ‘Ben onu şöyle şöyle sanıyorum; onun hesabını Allah görür. Allah’a karşı hiç kimseyi temize çıkarmam’ desin.”

en.sunnah_full_text: Abu Bakrah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: Mention of a man was made to the Prophet (ﷺ) and someone praised him whereupon he (ﷺ) said, "Woe be to you! You have broken the neck of your friend!" He repeated this several times and added, "If one of you has to praise his friend at all, he should say: 'I reckon him to be such and such and Allah knows him well', if you think him to be so-and-so, you will be accountable to Allah because no one can testify the purity of others against Allah.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that a man was mentioned in the presence of the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), and another man praised him favorably. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Woe to you! You have cut your companion’s neck.” He said this repeatedly. “If one of you must praise someone, then let him say: ‘I think him to be such and such,’ if he sees him to be so; and Allah is his Reckoner. No one should declare anyone pure before Allah.”
en.narrator: Abu Bakrah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن همام بن الحارث، عن المقداد، رضي الله عنه أم رجلا جعل يمدح عثمان رضي الله عنه ، فعمد المقداد، فجثا على ركبتيه، فجعل يحثو في وجهه الحصباء، فقال له عثمان: ما شأنك؟ فقال: إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “إذا رأيتم المادحين، فاحثوا في وجوههم التراب" فهذه الأحاديث في النهي، وجاء في الإباحة أحاديث كثيرة صحيحة. قال العلماء: وطريق الجمع بين الأحاديث أن يقال: إن كان الممدوح عنده كمال إيمان ويقين، ورياضة نفس، ومعرفة تامة بحيث لا يفتن، ولا يغتر بذلك، ولا تلعب به نفسه، فليس بحرام ولا مكروه، وإن خيف عليه شيء من هذه الأمور، كره مدحه في وجهه كراهة شديدة، وعلى هذا التفصيل تنزل الأحاديث المختلفة في ذلك. ومما جاء في الإباحة قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم لأبي بكر رضي الله عنه: “أرجو أن تكون منهم" أي من الذين يُدعون من جميع أبواب الجنة لدخولها، وفي الحديث الآخر: "لست منهم" أي: لست من الذين يُسبلون أُزرهم خيلاء. وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم لعمر رضي الله عنه: “ما رآك الشيطان سالكًا فجًا إلا سلك فجًا غير فجك” والأحاديث في الإباحة كثيرة، وقد ذكرت جملة من أطرافها في كتاب: "الأذكار".

tr.diyanet_full_text: Ebû Mûsâ’nın (ra) şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: Peygamber bir kimsenin, birini aşırı bir şekilde övdüğünü işitince: “Adamı mahvettiniz!” ya da “Adamın belini kırdınız!”, buyurdu.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Hemmâm b. el-Hâris’ten, Mikdâd radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre bir adam Osman radıyallahu anh’ı övmeye başladı. Bunun üzerine Mikdâd ona yöneldi, dizlerinin üzerine çöktü ve yüzüne çakıl serpmeye başladı. Osman ona: “Sana ne oluyor?” dedi. O da şöyle dedi: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Övücüleri gördüğünüzde yüzlerine toprak saçın.” Bu hadisler yasaklama hakkındadır; buna karşılık övgünün câiz olduğuna dair birçok sahih hadis de gelmiştir. Âlimler şöyle demiştir: Hadisleri birleştirmenin yolu şudur: Övülen kimsede iman ve yakîn kemali, nefis terbiyesi ve tam bir bilgi bulunur da bununla fitneye düşmez, gurura kapılmaz ve nefsi onunla oynamazsa, onu yüzüne karşı övmek haram da mekruh da değildir. Fakat onun hakkında bu hususlardan birinden korkulursa, yüzüne karşı övülmesi şiddetle mekruh olur. Bu konudaki farklı hadisler bu ayrıntıya göre değerlendirilir. Câiz olduğuna dair gelenlerden biri, Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in Ebû Bekir radıyallahu anh’a: “Onlardan olmanı umarım” buyurmasıdır; yani cennete girmek için bütün kapılarından çağrılanlardan. Diğer hadiste de: “Sen onlardan değilsin” buyurmuştur; yani elbiselerini kibirle sürüyenlerden değilsin. Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem Ömer radıyallahu anh’a da şöyle buyurmuştur: “Şeytan seni bir yolda yürürken görse, mutlaka senin yolundan başka bir yola girer.” Câizliğe dair hadisler çoktur; bunların bir kısmının uçlarını “el-Ezkâr” adlı kitapta zikrettim.

en.sunnah_full_text: Hammam bin Al- Harith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A person began to praise 'Uthman (May Allah be pleased with him), and Al-Miqdad (May Allah be pleased with him) sat upon his knees and began to throw pebbles upon the flatterer's face. 'Uthman (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "What is the matter with you?" He said: "Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'When you see those who shower undue praises upon others throw dust upon their faces."'.
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Hammam ibn al-Harith reported from al-Miqdad (may Allah be pleased with him) that a man began praising ‘Uthman (may Allah be pleased with him). Al-Miqdad went toward him, knelt on his knees, and began throwing pebbles in his face. ‘Uthman said to him: “What is the matter with you?” He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “When you see those who praise, throw dust in their faces.” These hadiths concern prohibition, while many authentic hadiths have come permitting praise. The scholars said: The way to reconcile the hadiths is to say: If the one praised possesses complete faith and certainty, discipline of the soul, and full knowledge such that he is not put to trial, does not become self-deluded, and his ego does not play with him because of it, then praising him to his face is neither unlawful nor disliked. But if any of these matters is feared for him, then praising him to his face is strongly disliked. The differing hadiths on this matter are understood according to this distinction. Among what has come regarding permissibility is the Prophet’s saying to Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him): “I hope you will be among them,” meaning among those who will be called from all the gates of Paradise to enter it. In the other hadith: “You are not among them,” meaning you are not among those who let their lower garments hang out of pride. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him): “Satan never sees you taking a path except that he takes a path other than yours.” The hadiths concerning permissibility are many, and I have mentioned a number of their indications in the book al-Adhkar.
en.narrator: Hammam bin Al- Harith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:

In the other hadith: “You are not among them,” meaning you are not among those who let their lower garments hang out of pride. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said to ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him): “Satan never sees you taking a path except that he takes a path other than yours.” The hadiths concerning permissibility are many, and I have mentioned a number of their indications in the book al-Adhkar.
original_columns.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن همام بن الحارث، عن المقداد، رضي الله عنه أم رجلا جعل يمدح عثمان رضي الله عنه ، فعمد المقداد، فجثا على ركبتيه، فجعل يحثو في وجهه الحصباء، فقال له عثمان: ما شأنك؟ فقال: إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “إذا رأيتم المادحين، فاحثوا في وجوههم التراب" فهذه الأحاديث في النهي، وجاء في الإباحة أحاديث كثيرة صحيحة. قال العلماء: وطريق الجمع بين الأحاديث أن يقال: إن كان الممدوح عنده كمال إيمان ويقين، ورياضة نفس، ومعرفة تامة بحيث لا يفتن، ولا يغتر بذلك، ولا تلعب به نفسه، فليس بحرام ولا مكروه، وإن خيف عليه شيء من هذه الأمور، كره مدحه في وجهه كراهة شديدة، وعلى هذا التفصيل تنزل الأحاديث المختلفة في ذلك. ومما جاء في الإباحة قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم لأبي بكر رضي الله عنه: “أرجو أن تكون منهم" أي من الذين يُدعون من جميع أبواب الجنة لدخولها، وفي الحديث الآخر: "لست منهم" أي: لست من الذين يُسبلون أُزرهم خيلاء. وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم لعمر رضي الله عنه: “ما رآك الشيطان سالكًا فجًا إلا سلك فجًا غير فجك” والأحاديث في الإباحة كثيرة، وقد ذكرت جملة من أطرافها في كتاب: "الأذكار".
original_columns.turkish_full_text: Ebû Mûsâ’nın (ra) şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: Peygamber bir kimsenin, birini aşırı bir şekilde övdüğünü işitince: “Adamı mahvettiniz!” ya da “Adamın belini kırdınız!”, buyurdu.
original_columns.english_full_text: Hammam bin Al- Harith (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: A person began to praise 'Uthman (May Allah be pleased with him), and Al-Miqdad (May Allah be pleased with him) sat upon his knees and began to throw pebbles upon the flatterer's face. 'Uthman (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "What is the matter with you?" He said: "Verily, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'When you see those who shower undue praises upon others throw dust upon their faces."'.

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنه أن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه خرج إلى الشام حتى إذا كان بسرغ لقيه أمراء الأجناد -أبو عبيدة بن الجراح وأصحابه- فأخبروه أن الوباء قد وقع بالشام، قال بن عباس: فقال عمر: ادع لي المهاجرين الأولين، فدعوتهم، فاستشارهم، وأخبرهم أن الوباء قد وقع بالشام، فاختلفوا، فقال بعضهم: خرجت لأمر، ولا نرى أن ترجع عنه. وقال بعضهم: معك بقية الناس وأصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ، ولا نرى أن تقدمهم على هذا الوباء. فقال: ارتفعوا عني، ثم قال: ادع لي الأنصار، فدعوتهم، فاستشارهم، فسلكوا سبيل المهاجرين، واختلفوا كاختلافهم، فقال: ارتفعوا عني، ثم قال: ادع لي من كان ها هنا من مشيخة قريش من مهاجرة الفتح، فدعوتهم، فلم يختلف عليه منهم رجلان، فقالوا: نرى أن ترجع بالناس، ولا تقدمهم على هذا الوباء، فنادى عمر رضي الله عنه في الناس: إني مصبح على ظهر، فأصبحوا عليه فقال أبو عبيدة بن الجراح رضي الله عنه : أفرار من قدر الله؟ فقال عمر رضي الله عنه : لو غيرك قالها يا أبا عبيدة! -وكان عمر يكره خلافه- نعم نفر من قدر الله إلى قدر الله، أرأيت لو كان لك إبل، فهبطت وادياً له عدوتان، إحداهما خصبة، والأخرى جدبة، أليس إن رعيت الخصبة رعيتها بقدر الله، وإن رعيت الجدبة رعيتها بقدر الله؟ قال: فجاء عبد الرحمن بن عوف رضي الله عنه ، وكان متغيباً في بعض حاجته، فقال: إن عندي من هذا علما، سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: “إذا سمعتم به بأرض، فلا تقدموا عليه، وإذا وقع بأرض وأنتم بها، فلا تخرجوا فرارا منه" فحمد الله تعالى عمر رضي الله عنه وانصرف. والعدوة: جانب الوادي.

tr.diyanet_full_text: Ebû Bekre’nin (ra) şöyle dediği nakledilmiştir: Bir gün Peygamber’in huzurunda bir kimsenin ismi anılmış ve orada bulunanlardan biri, onu aşırı bir şekilde övmüştü. Bunun üzerine Hz. Peygamber birkaç defa: “Yazık sana, dostunun boynunu kopardın, (onu mahvettin)”, dedi. Sonra da: “Şayet biriniz diğerini mutlaka övecek olursa, ‘öyle sanıyorum ki o, şöyle iyidir, böyle iyidir.’ desin ve bu sözü de adamın bu sıfatlara sahip olduğu kanaatindeyse söylesin. Onun iç yüzünü Allah bilir, ona göre hesaba çeker. Şu hâlde kimse, Allah’a karşı kesin bir şekilde tezkiye edilemez (temize çıkarılamaz).” buyurdu.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: İbn Abbâs radıyallahu anhümâ’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Ömer b. el-Hattâb radıyallahu anh Şam’a doğru yola çıktı. Serğ denilen yere vardığında ordu komutanları Ebû Ubeyde b. el-Cerrâh ve arkadaşları onunla karşılaştı ve Şam’da veba çıktığını haber verdiler. İbn Abbâs dedi ki: Ömer: “Bana ilk muhacirleri çağır” dedi. Onları çağırdım; onlarla istişare etti ve Şam’da veba çıktığını bildirdi. Onlar ihtilaf ettiler. Bazıları: “Sen bir iş için çıktın; ondan geri dönmeni uygun görmüyoruz” dedi. Bazıları da: “Yanında insanların kalanı ve Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in ashâbı var; onları bu vebanın üzerine götürmeni uygun görmüyoruz” dedi. Ömer: “Yanımdan ayrılın” dedi. Sonra: “Bana ensarı çağır” dedi. Onları çağırdım; onlarla istişare etti. Onlar da muhacirlerin yolunu izlediler ve onların ihtilaf ettiği gibi ihtilaf ettiler. Ömer: “Yanımdan ayrılın” dedi. Sonra: “Burada bulunan, fetih muhacirlerinden Kureyş’in yaşlılarını bana çağır” dedi. Onları çağırdım. Onlardan iki kişi bile ihtilaf etmedi; şöyle dediler: “İnsanlarla birlikte geri dönmeni ve onları bu vebanın üzerine götürmemeni uygun görürüz.” Bunun üzerine Ömer radıyallahu anh insanlar arasında: “Ben sabahleyin bineğimin üzerinde yola çıkacağım; siz de sabahleyin yola çıkın” diye seslendi. Ebû Ubeyde b. el-Cerrâh radıyallahu anh: “Allah’ın kaderinden mi kaçıyorsun?” dedi. Ömer radıyallahu anh: “Keşke bunu senden başkası söyleseydi ey Ebû Ubeyde!” dedi; Ömer onun muhalefet etmesini istemezdi. “Evet, Allah’ın kaderinden Allah’ın kaderine kaçıyoruz. Bir deve sürün olsa ve iki yamacı bulunan bir vadiye insen; yamaçlardan biri verimli, diğeri çorak olsa; verimli yerde otlatsan Allah’ın kaderiyle otlatmış olmaz mısın? Çorak yerde otlatsan da Allah’ın kaderiyle otlatmış olmaz mısın?” dedi. Sonra Abdurrahman b. Avf radıyallahu anh geldi; bazı ihtiyaçları sebebiyle orada bulunmuyordu. Dedi ki: “Bu konuda bende bilgi vardır. Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’i şöyle buyururken işittim: ‘Onun bir yerde olduğunu işitirseniz oraya gitmeyin. Bulunduğunuz yerde ortaya çıkarsa, ondan kaçmak için oradan çıkmayın.’” Bunun üzerine Ömer radıyallahu anh Allah Teâlâ’ya hamdetti ve geri döndü. “Adve”, vadinin kenarı demektir.

en.sunnah_full_text: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: 'Umar bin Al- Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) set out for Ash-Sham (the region comprising Syria, Palestine, Lebanon and Jordan). As he reached at Sargh (a town by the side of Hijaz) he came across the governor of Al-Ajnad, Abu 'Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (May Allah be pleased with him) and his companions. They informed him that an had broken out in Syria. Ibn 'Abbas relates: 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Call to me the earliest Muhajirun (Emigrants)." So I called them. He sought their advice and told them that an epidemic had broken out in Ash-Sham. There was a difference of opinion whether they should proceed further or retreat to their homes in such a situation. Some of them said: "You have set forth to fight the enemy, and therefore you should not go back;" whereas some of them said: "As you have along with you many eminent Companions of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we would not advice you to set forth to the place of the plague (and thus expose them deliberately to a danger)." 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "You can now go away." He said: "Call to me the Ansar (the Helpers)." So I called them to him, and he consulted them and they differed in their opinions as well. He said: "Now, you may go." He again said: "Call the old (wise people) of the Quraish who had emigrated before the conquest of Makkah." I called them. 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) consulted them in this issue and not even two persons among them differed in the opinions. They said: "We think that you should go back along with the people and do not take them to this scourge. 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) made an announcement to the people, saying: "In the morning I intend to go back, and I want you to do the same." Abu 'Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "Are you going to run away from the Divine Decree?" Thereupon 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "O Abu 'Ubaidah ! Had it been someone else to say this." ('Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) did not like to differ with him). He said: "Yes, we are running from the Divine Decree to the Divine Decree. What do you think if you have camels and you happen to get down a valley having two sides, one of them covered with foliage and the other being barren, will you not act according to the Divine Decree if you graze them in vegetative land? In case you graze them in the barren land, even then you will be doing so according to the Divine Decree.There happened to come 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf who had been absent for some of his needs. He said: I have knowledge about it. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "If you get wind of the outbreak of plague in a land, you should not enter it; but if it spreads in the land where you are, you should not depart from it." Thereupon 'Umar bin Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) praised Allah and went back.
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ibn ‘Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both) reported that ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him) set out for Syria. When he reached Sargh, the commanders of the armies—Abu ‘Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah and his companions—met him and informed him that plague had broken out in Syria. Ibn ‘Abbas said: ‘Umar said: “Call the first Muhajirun for me.” I called them, and he consulted them, informing them that plague had broken out in Syria. They differed. Some said: “You set out for a matter, and we do not think you should turn back from it.” Others said: “With you are the remaining people and the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him), and we do not think you should bring them upon this plague.” He said: “Leave me.” Then he said: “Call the Ansar for me.” I called them, and he consulted them. They followed the way of the Muhajirun and differed as they had differed. He said: “Leave me.” Then he said: “Call for me those here of the elders of Quraysh from the Muhajirun of the Conquest.” I called them, and not two of them differed with him. They said: “We think you should return with the people and not bring them upon this plague.” So ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) called out among the people: “I will be mounted in the morning, so be mounted in the morning.” Abu ‘Ubaydah ibn al-Jarrah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “Are you fleeing from the decree of Allah?” ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) said: “If only someone other than you had said it, O Abu ‘Ubaydah!”—for ‘Umar disliked opposing him. “Yes, we flee from the decree of Allah to the decree of Allah. What do you think: if you had camels and descended into a valley with two sides, one fertile and the other barren, would you not, if you grazed them on the fertile side, graze them by the decree of Allah, and if you grazed them on the barren side, graze them by the decree of Allah?” Then ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn ‘Awf (may Allah be pleased with him) came; he had been absent for some need of his. He said: “I have knowledge concerning this. I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) say: ‘If you hear of it in a land, do not go to it; and if it occurs in a land while you are there, do not leave fleeing from it.’” So ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him) praised Allah Most High and turned back. Al-‘udwah means the side of the valley.

Onun iç yüzünü Allah bilir, ona göre hesaba çeker. Şu hâlde kimse, Allah’a karşı kesin bir şekilde tezkiye edilemez (temize çıkarılamaz).” buyurdu.
original_columns.english_full_text: Ibn 'Abbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported: 'Umar bin Al- Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) set out for Ash-Sham (the region comprising Syria, Palestine, Lebanon and Jordan). As he reached at Sargh (a town by the side of Hijaz) he came across the governor of Al-Ajnad, Abu 'Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (May Allah be pleased with him) and his companions. They informed him that an had broken out in Syria. Ibn 'Abbas relates: 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said to me: "Call to me the earliest Muhajirun (Emigrants)." So I called them. He sought their advice and told them that an epidemic had broken out in Ash-Sham. There was a difference of opinion whether they should proceed further or retreat to their homes in such a situation. Some of them said: "You have set forth to fight the enemy, and therefore you should not go back;" whereas some of them said: "As you have along with you many eminent Companions of Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), we would not advice you to set forth to the place of the plague (and thus expose them deliberately to a danger)." 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "You can now go away." He said: "Call to me the Ansar (the Helpers)." So I called them to him, and he consulted them and they differed in their opinions as well. He said: "Now, you may go." He again said: "Call the old (wise people) of the Quraish who had emigrated before the conquest of Makkah." I called them. 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) consulted them in this issue and not even two persons among them differed in the opinions. They said: "We think that you should go back along with the people and do not take them to this scourge. 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) made an announcement to the people, saying: "In the morning I intend to go back, and I want you to do the same." Abu 'Ubaidah bin Al-Jarrah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "Are you going to run away from the Divine Decree?" Thereupon 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) said: "O Abu 'Ubaidah ! Had it been someone else to say this." ('Umar (May Allah be pleased with him) did not like to differ with him). He said: "Yes, we are running from the Divine Decree to the Divine Decree. What do you think if you have camels and you happen to get down a valley having two sides, one of them covered with foliage and the other being barren, will you not act according to the Divine Decree if you graze them in vegetative land? In case you graze them in the barren land, even then you will be doing so according to the Divine Decree.There happened to come 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Auf who had been absent for some of his needs. He said: I have knowledge about it. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "If you get wind of the outbreak of plague in a land, you should not enter it; but if it spreads in the land where you are, you should not depart from it." Thereupon 'Umar bin Khattab (May Allah be pleased with him) praised Allah and went back.

tr.diyanet_full_text: Hemmâm b. Hâris’in, Mikdâd’dan (ra) rivayet ettiğine göre bir gün bir adam Hz. Osman’ı övmeye başlayınca, orada bulunan Mikdâd, diz çökerek öven kişinin yüzüne ufacık taşları atmaya başladı. Bunun üzerine Hz. Osman: –Ne yapıyorsun, deyince o da: –Resûlullah , “İnsanları övüp duranları gördüğünüz zaman yüzlerine toprak saçın.” buyurdu, dedi.

ar.sunnah_full_text: عن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: “أجتنبوا السبع الموبقات” قالوا: يا رسول الله وما هن؟ قال: "الشرك بالله، والسحر، وقتل النفس التى حرم الله إلا بالحق، وأكل الربا، وأكل مال اليتيم، والتولي يوم الزحف، وقذف المحصنات الغافلات”

tr.diyanet_full_text: İbn Abbâs’ın (ra) şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: Ömer b. Hattâb (ra), (halifeliği zamanında bir grup askerle beraber) Şam’a gitmişti. ‘Serğ’ denilen köye varınca (ordu kumandanı) Ebû Ubeyde b. Cerrâh bazı komutanlarla birlikte Hz. Ömer’i karşılayarak, o bölgede veba salgını olduğunu haber verdi. İbn Abbâs diyor ki: Bu haber üzerine Ömer (ra) bana: –İlk muhacirleri yanıma çağır, dedi. Onları çağırdım. Hz. Ömer, onlarla istişare etti. Sahâbîler ihtilafa düştü. Bir kısmı: –(Ey müminlerin emîri!) Sen belli bir iş (düşmanla savaşmak) için yola çıktın. Bu yoldan dönmeni uygun görmüyoruz, dedi. Bazıları da: –Beraberinde Resûlullah’ın ashâbı ile geride kalan halk var ve biz onları vebanın içine götürmeni uygun görmüyoruz (Medine’ye geri dönme fikrindeyiz), dediler. Hz. Ömer (bu ihtilafı görünce): –Yanımdan kalkın, gidin, dedi. Sonra bana: –Ensarı çağır, dedi. Onları davet ettim. Onlarla da istişare etti. Ensar da muhacirler gibi ihtilafa düştüler. Ömer (ra) onlara: –Siz de çıkın, dedi. Sonra bana: –Mekke’nin fethinden evvel Medine’ye hicret etmiş olan buradaki Kureyş muhacirlerinin yaşlılarını çağır, dedi. Onları da çağırdım. Onlarla da istişare etti. Bunlar ihtilaf etmeyip hepsi de: Halk ile birlikte Medine’ye geri dönüp vebanın üzerine varmamanızı uygun görüyoruz, dediler. Bunun üzerine Hz. Ömer, insanlara seslendi ve kendisinin sabah yola çıkacağını ilan etti. Onlara, “Siz de hazırlanın” dedi. İşte tam o sırada Ebû Ubeyde b. Cerrâh (ra), (bu karara itiraz ederek): –Allah’ın kaderinden mi kaçıyorsun, deyince halife Ömer (onun karşı çıkmasını hoş görmeyerek): –Ey Ebû Ubeyde, keşke bu sözü sen değil de, başkası söyleseydi, dedikten sonra: –Evet, Allah’ın kaderinden yine Allah’ın kaderine kaçıyoruz. Düşün ki senin develerin bir tarafı otlak, diğer tarafı çıplak bir vadiye inmiş olsaydı, o develeri otlu yamaçta otlatır, karınlarını doyurursan senin bu amelin, Allah’ın kaderiyle olmaz mı? Aksine çıplak tarafında aç bırakırsan yine Allah’ın kaderi ile gütmüş olmaz mısın? dedi. Ravi İbn Abbâs diyor ki: Bu sırada, bir takım ihtiyaçlarını görmek için orada bulunamayan Abdurrahmân b. Avf geldi. (Durumdan haberdar olunca): Bu hususa dair bende malumat var. Resûlullah’tan işittim: “Bir yerde veba olduğunu işittiğiniz zaman oraya gitmeyin, bulunduğunuz yerde veba baş gösterince de hastalıktan kaçarak oradan çıkmayın.”, buyurdu, dedi. Bunun üzerine Hz. Ömer (görüşünün bu hadise uygun düşmüş olmasından dolayı) Allah Teâlâ’ya hamd ü sena edip, (Medine’ye) geri döndü.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh’tan, Peygamber sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurmuştur: “Helâk edici yedi şeyden sakının.” Sahâbîler: “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, bunlar nelerdir?” dediler. O şöyle buyurdu: “Allah’a ortak koşmak, sihir, Allah’ın haram kıldığı canı haksız yere öldürmek, faiz yemek, yetim malı yemek, savaş günü geriye dönüp kaçmak ve iffetli, hiçbir şeyden habersiz mümin kadınlara zina isnadında bulunmak.”

en.sunnah_full_text: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Avoid the seven destructive things." It was asked: (by those present): "What are they, O Messenger of Allah?" He replied, "Associating anyone or anything with Allah in worship; practising sorcery, killing of someone without a just cause whom Allah has forbidden, devouring the property of an orphan, eating of usury, fleeing from the battlefield and slandering chaste women who never even think of anything touching chastity and are good believers.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) that he said: “Avoid the seven destructive sins.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, what are they?” He said: “Associating partners with Allah, magic, killing the soul whom Allah has forbidden except by right, consuming usury, consuming the property of the orphan, turning away on the day of battle, and slandering chaste, unsuspecting women.”
en.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

ar.sunnah_full_text: عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "الذي يشرب في آنية الفضة إنما يجرجر في بطنه نار جهنم" وفي رواية لمسلم: "أن الذي يأكل أو يشرب في آنية الفضة والذهب"

tr.diyanet_full_text: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber : –Helâk edici şu yedi günahtan sakının, buyurdu. Sahâbîler: –Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, bunlar nelerdir, diye sordular. Peygamber : –Allah’a ortak koşmak, büyü yapmak, –hukukun gerektirdiğinin dışında– Allah’ın öldürülmesini haram kıldığı bir kimseyi öldürmek, faiz yemek, yetim malı yemek, düşman ile savaş yapılırken kaçmak, evli ve hiçbir şeyden haberi olmayan namuslu mümin bir kadına zina iftirası atmaktır, buyurdu.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ümmü Seleme radıyallahu anhâ’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Gümüş kaptan içen kimse, karnına ancak cehennem ateşini gürletircesine doldurur.” Müslim’in bir rivayetinde: “Gümüş ve altın kapta yiyen veya içen kimse...” şeklindedir.

en.sunnah_full_text: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whosoever drinks in utensils of silver, in fact, kindles in his belly the fire of Hell.".The narration of Muslim is: "Verily, the person who eats or drinks in utensils made of gold and silver."
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Umm Salamah (may Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “The one who drinks from a vessel of silver is only gurgling the fire of Hell into his belly.” In a narration of Muslim: “The one who eats or drinks from vessels of silver and gold...”
en.narrator: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said:

original_columns.CPT_turkish_translation: Ümmü Seleme radıyallahu anhâ’dan rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Gümüş kaptan içen kimse, karnına ancak cehennem ateşini gürletircesine doldurur.” Müslim’in bir rivayetinde: “Gümüş ve altın kapta yiyen veya içen kimse...” şeklindedir.
original_columns.CPT_english_translation: Umm Salamah (may Allah be pleased with her) reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “The one who drinks from a vessel of silver is only gurgling the fire of Hell into his belly.” In a narration of Muslim: “The one who eats or drinks from vessels of silver and gold...”
original_columns.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: عن أم سلمة رضي الله عنها أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "الذي يشرب في آنية الفضة إنما يجرجر في بطنه نار جهنم" وفي رواية لمسلم: "أن الذي يأكل أو يشرب في آنية الفضة والذهب"
original_columns.turkish_full_text: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber : –Helâk edici şu yedi günahtan sakının, buyurdu. Sahâbîler: –Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, bunlar nelerdir, diye sordular. Peygamber : –Allah’a ortak koşmak, büyü yapmak, –hukukun gerektirdiğinin dışında– Allah’ın öldürülmesini haram kıldığı bir kimseyi öldürmek, faiz yemek, yetim malı yemek, düşman ile savaş yapılırken kaçmak, evli ve hiçbir şeyden haberi olmayan namuslu mümin bir kadına zina iftirası atmaktır, buyurdu.
original_columns.english_full_text: Umm Salamah (May Allah be pleased with her) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whosoever drinks in utensils of silver, in fact, kindles in his belly the fire of Hell.".The narration of Muslim is: "Verily, the person who eats or drinks in utensils made of gold and silver."
original_columns.kaynak_tr: B2766 Buhârî, Vesâyâ, 23; M262 Müslim, Îmân, 145

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن حذيفة رضي الله عنه، قال: إن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نهانا عن الحرير، والديباج والشرب في آنية الذهب والفضة، وقال: "هن لهم في الدنيا وهم لكم في الاخرة" وفي رواية في الصحيحين عن حذيفة رضي الله عنه، قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "لا تلبسوا الحرير ولا الديباج، ولا تشربوا في آنية الذهب والفضة ولا تأكلوا في صحافها".

tr.diyanet_full_text: Abdullah b. Ömer’in (ra), Resûlullah , Kur’an ile düşman diyarına yolculuğu yasakladı, dediği rivayet edilmiştir.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Huzeyfe radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem bize ipekten, dîbâcdan ve altın ile gümüş kaplardan içmekten sakındırdı ve şöyle buyurdu: “Bunlar dünyada onlarındır, âhirette ise sizindir.” Sahîhayn’da Huzeyfe radıyallahu anh’tan gelen bir rivayette şöyle dediği nakledilmiştir: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’i şöyle buyururken işittim: “İpek ve dîbâc giymeyiniz; altın ve gümüş kaplardan içmeyiniz, onların tabaklarında da yemeyiniz.”

en.sunnah_full_text: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (ﷺ) prohibited us from wearing silk or Dibaj and from drinking out of gold and silver vessels and said, "These are meant for them (non- Muslims) in this world and for you in the Hereafter."In another narration Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Do not wear silk and Dibaj, nor eat or drink from utensils made of gold and silver.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Hudhayfah (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) forbade us silk, brocade, and drinking from vessels of gold and silver, and said: “They are for them in this world, and for you in the Hereafter.” In a narration in the two Sahihs from Hudhayfah (may Allah be pleased with him), he said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) say: “Do not wear silk or brocade; do not drink from vessels of gold and silver, and do not eat from their dishes.”
en.narrator: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن أنس بن سيرين قال: كنت مع أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه عند نفر من المجوس، فجيء بفالوذج على إناء من فضة، فلم يأكله، فقيل له: حوله، فحوله على إناء من خلنج، وجيء به فأكله. الخلنج الجفنة

tr.diyanet_full_text: Ümmü Seleme’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Resûlullah : Gümüş kaptan bir şey içen kimse, karnına ancak cehennem ateşi doldurmuş olur, buyurdu. Müslim’in rivayetinde: “Gümüş ve altın kaplardan yemek yiyen veya içen…” denilmiştir.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Enes b. Sîrîn şöyle dedi: Enes b. Mâlik radıyallahu anh ile birlikte Mecûsîlerden bir topluluğun yanındaydım. Gümüş bir kap içinde fâlûzec getirildi; fakat o bundan yemedi. Kendisine, “Onu başka bir kaba aktar.” denildi. O da onu halencden yapılmış bir kaba aktardı; sonra yemek getirildi ve ondan yedi. “Halenc”, büyük yemek kabı demektir.

en.sunnah_full_text: Anas bin Sirin (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I was with Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) in the company of some Magians when Faludhaj (a sweet made of flour and honey) was brought in a silver utensil, and Anas did not take it. The man was told to change the utensil. So he changed the utensil and when he brought it to Anas, he took it.
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Anas ibn Sirin said: I was with Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) among a group of Magians. Some fālūdhaj was brought in a silver vessel, but he did not eat from it. It was said to him, “Transfer it.” So he transferred it to a vessel made of khalanj, and it was brought, and he ate from it. “Khalanj” means a large serving bowl.
en.narrator: Anas bin Sirin (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن عبد الله بن عمرو بن العاص رضي الله عنه قال: رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم علي ثوبين معصفرين فقال: "أمك أمرتك بهذا؟" قلت: أغسلهما؟ قال: "بل احرقهما". وفي رواية فقال: "إن هذا من ثياب الكفار فلا تلبسها"

tr.diyanet_full_text: Enes b. Sîrîn’in şöyle dediği rivayet edilmiştir: Bir gün Enes b. Mâlik ile birlikte Mecûsîlerden bir grubun yanında idim. Bize gümüşten bir kap içinde paluze (bir tür tatlı) getirildi. Enes bunu yemedi. Onu getirene, “Bu paluzeyi başka bir kaba boşalt.” denildi. O da onu çam ağacından yapılmış bir çanağa aktarıp getirdi. Bunun üzerine Enes ondan yedi. (BS104 Beyhakî, es-Sünenü’l-Kübrâ, I, 57) riyaz3-131 Erkeklerin Giyimi
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Abdullah b. Amr b. el-Âs radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem üzerimde usfurla boyanmış iki elbise gördü ve şöyle buyurdu: “Bunu sana annen mi emretti?” Ben, “Onları yıkayayım mı?” dedim. O, “Hayır, onları yak.” buyurdu. Bir rivayette şöyle buyurduğu nakledilmiştir: “Şüphesiz bu, kâfirlerin elbiselerindendir; onu giyme.”

en.sunnah_full_text: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) saw me dressed in two saffron-coloured garments and asked, "Has your mother commanded you to wear these?" I asked him, "Shall I wash them out?" He replied, "You had better set them to fire."Another narration is: "These are garments of the disbelievers. So do not wear them.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: ‘Abdullah ibn ‘Amr ibn al-‘As (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) saw two garments dyed with safflower on me and said: “Did your mother command you to wear this?” I said, “Shall I wash them?” He said: “Rather, burn them.” In another narration, he said: “Indeed, this is from the garments of the disbelievers, so do not wear it.”
en.narrator: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) said:

ar.sunnah_full_text: عن عليّ رضي الله عنه قال: حفظت عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لا يتم بعد احتلام، ولا صمات يوم إلى الليل". قال الخطابي في تفسير هذا الحديث: كان من نسك الجاهلية الصمات، فنهوا في الإسلام عن ذلك، وأمروا بالذكر والحديث بالخير.

tr.diyanet_full_text: Enes’ten (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber , bir erkeğin (teninde veya giysisinde) zağferan (safran) kullanmasını yasaklamıştır.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ali radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’den şunu belledim: “İhtilamdan sonra yetimlik yoktur; gündüzden geceye kadar susma ibadeti de yoktur.” Hattâbî bu hadisin açıklamasında şöyle demiştir: Câhiliye döneminin ibadet şekillerinden biri susmaktı. İslâm’da bundan nehyedildiler; zikretmek ve hayırlı söz söylemekle emrolundular.

en.sunnah_full_text: 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I have retained in my memory the saying of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that: "No one is considered an orphan after he has attained the age of maturity; and it is unlawful to remain silent from dawn till night.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: ‘Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: I memorized from the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him): “There is no orphanhood after puberty, and there is no remaining silent for a day until night.” Al-Khattabi said in explaining this hadith: Silence was among the devotional practices of the pre-Islamic period; in Islam they were forbidden from that and commanded to remember Allah and speak good words.
en.narrator: 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

sources.tr: B5846 Buhârî, Libâs, 33; M5507 Müslim, Libâs, 77

İslâm’da bundan nehyedildiler; zikretmek ve hayırlı söz söylemekle emrolundular.
original_columns.CPT_english_translation: ‘Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: I memorized from the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him): “There is no orphanhood after puberty, and there is no remaining silent for a day until night.” Al-Khattabi said in explaining this hadith: Silence was among the devotional practices of the pre-Islamic period; in Islam they were forbidden from that and commanded to remember Allah and speak good words.
original_columns.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: عن عليّ رضي الله عنه قال: حفظت عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "لا يتم بعد احتلام، ولا صمات يوم إلى الليل". قال الخطابي في تفسير هذا الحديث: كان من نسك الجاهلية الصمات، فنهوا في الإسلام عن ذلك، وأمروا بالذكر والحديث بالخير.
original_columns.turkish_full_text: Enes’ten (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber , bir erkeğin (teninde veya giysisinde) zağferan (safran) kullanmasını yasaklamıştır.
original_columns.english_full_text: 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I have retained in my memory the saying of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) that: "No one is considered an orphan after he has attained the age of maturity; and it is unlawful to remain silent from dawn till night.".

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن قيس بن أبي حازم قال: دخل أبو بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه على امرأة من أحمس يقال لها: زينب، فرأها لا تتكلم. فقال: ما لها لا تتكلم؟ فقالوا: حجت مصمته، فقال لها: تكلمي فإن هذا لا يحل، هذا من عمل الجاهلية! فتكلمت. رواه البخاري

tr.diyanet_full_text: Abdullah b. Amr b. Âs’tan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre o, şöyle demiştir: Peygamber , safranla boyanmış iki elbiseyi üzerimde gördü de: –Bu elbiseyi giymeyi sana annen mi emretti, deyince: –Onları yıkayayım (ey Allah’ın Resûlü), dedim. –Hatta bunları yak, diye emretti. Müslim’in diğer rivayetinde: Bu, kâfirlerin giydiği elbiselerdendir, onu giyme, buyurmuştur.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Kays b. Ebû Hâzim şöyle dedi: Ebû Bekir es-Sıddîk radıyallahu anh, Ahmes kabilesinden Zeyneb denilen bir kadının yanına girdi. Onun konuşmadığını görünce, “Buna ne oluyor da konuşmuyor?” dedi. “Susarak hac yaptı.” dediler. Bunun üzerine ona, “Konuş! Çünkü bu helâl değildir; bu câhiliye işidir.” dedi. Kadın da konuştu. Bunu Buhârî rivayet etmiştir.

en.sunnah_full_text: Qais bin Abu Hazim (May Allah be pleased with him) said: Abu Bakr (May Allah be pleased with him) came upon a woman named Zainab from the Ahmas tribe and noticed that she was observing total silence. He said: "What has happened to her? Why does she not speak?'' People informed him that she had sworn to remain silent. He then said to her: "You should speak, it is not permissible (to observe silence), for it is an act of the Days of Ignorance (Jahiliyyah)." (After hearing this) she started speaking.
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Qays ibn Abi Hazim said: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him) entered upon a woman from Ahmas named Zaynab and saw that she was not speaking. He said, “What is the matter with her that she does not speak?” They said, “She performed Hajj while observing silence.” He said to her, “Speak, for this is not lawful; this is one of the practices of the pre-Islamic period.” So she spoke. Al-Bukhari narrated it.
en.narrator: Qais bin Abu Hazim (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

en.sunnah_full_text: Sa'd bin Abu Waqqas (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who (falsely) attributes his fatherhood to anyone besides his real father, knowing that he is not his father, will be forbidden to enter Jannah.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Sa‘d ibn Abi Waqqas (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Whoever claims affiliation to someone other than his father, while knowing that he is not his father, Paradise is forbidden to him.”

tr.diyanet_full_text: Kays b. Ebû Hâzim anlatıyor: Ebû Bekir (ra), Ahmes Kabilesi’nden Zeyneb adlı bir kadının yanına gelmişti. Kadının hiç konuşmadığını görünce: –Bu kadına ne oluyor da konuşmuyor, diye sordu. –Susarak hac yapıyor, dediler. Bunu duyan Hz. Ebû Bekir kadına: –Konuş, çünkü bu helâl değildir. Bu, Câhiliye işidir, buyurdu. Bunun üzerine Zeyneb de konuştu.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh’tan, Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in şöyle buyurduğu rivayet edilmiştir: “Babalarınızdan yüz çevirmeyiniz. Kim babasından yüz çevirirse, o küfür etmiş olur.”

en.sunnah_full_text: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Do not turn away from your fathers, for he who turns away from his father, will be guilty of committing an act of disbelief."

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن يزيد بن شريك بن طارق قال: رأيت عليا رضي الله عنه على المنبر يخطب، فسمعته يقول: لا والله ما عندنا من كتاب نقرؤه إلا كتاب الله، وما في هذه الصحيفة، فنشرها فإذا فيها أسنان الإبل، وأشياء من الجراحات، وفيها: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "المدينة حرم ما بين عير إلى ثور، فمن أحدث فيها حدثاً، أو آوى محدثاً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ذمة المسلمين واحدة، يسعى بها أدناهم، فمن أخفر مسلماً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ومن ادعى إلى غير أبيه، أو انتمى إلى غير مواليه، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً" "ذِمَّةُ المُسْلِمِينَ"أيْ: عَهْدُهُمْ وأمانتُهُم."وَأخْفَرَهُ": نَقَضَ عَهْدَهُ."والصَّرفُ": التَّوْبَةُ، وَقِيلَ: الحِيلَةُ."وَالْعَدْلُ": الفِدَاءُ.

tr.diyanet_full_text: Sa’d b. Ebû Vakkâs’tan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber şöyle buyurmuştur: Kim babası olmadığını bildiği hâlde, babasından başka birine “babamdır” diye neseb iddia ederse, cennet ona haramdır.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Yezîd b. Şerîk b. Târık şöyle dedi: Ali radıyallahu anh’ı minber üzerinde hutbe verirken gördüm ve şöyle dediğini işittim: “Hayır, Allah’a yemin ederim ki bizim yanımızda Allah’ın Kitabı’ndan ve şu sahîfede bulunanlardan başka okuduğumuz bir kitap yoktur.” Sonra sahîfeyi açtı; içinde develerin yaşlarına ve yaralanmalara dair bazı hükümler vardı. Orada şu da vardı: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Medine, Ayr ile Sevr arasında haram bölgedir. Kim orada bir bid‘at/zulüm ortaya çıkarır veya böyle birini barındırırsa, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün insanların lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah kıyamet günü ondan ne farz ne nafile, ne tevbe ne de fidye kabul eder. Müslümanların zimmeti birdir; onların en aşağı derecede olanı bile bu zimmeti verir. Kim bir Müslümanın ahdini bozarsa, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün insanların lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah kıyamet günü ondan ne farz ne nafile, ne tevbe ne de fidye kabul eder. Kim kendisini babasından başkasına nispet eder veya velâ bakımından asıl sahiplerinden başkasına intisap ederse, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün insanların lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah kıyamet günü ondan ne farz ne nafile, ne tevbe ne de fidye kabul eder.” “Müslümanların zimmeti” onların ahdi ve emânıdır. “Ahferahu” ahdini bozdu demektir. “Sarf” tevbe demektir; hile olduğu da söylenmiştir. “Adl” fidye demektir.

en.sunnah_full_text: Yazid bin Sharik bin Tariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I saw 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) giving a Khutbah (sermon) from the pulpit and I heard him saying: "By Allah, we have no book to read except Allah's Book and what is written in this scroll. He unrolled the scroll which showed a list of what sort of camels to be given as blood-money, and other legal matters relating to killing game in the sanctuary of Makkah and the expiation thereof. In it was also written: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Al-Madinah is a sanctuary from 'Air to Thaur (mountains). He who innovates in this territory new ideas in Islam, commits a sin therein, or shelters the innovators, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. The asylum (pledge of protection) granted by any Muslim (even of the) lowest status is to be honoured and respected by all other Muslims, and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect (by violating the pledge) will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people; and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever attributes his fatherhood to someone other than his (real) father, and takes someone else as his master other than his (real) master without his permission, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Yazid ibn Sharik ibn Tariq said: I saw ‘Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) on the pulpit delivering a sermon, and I heard him say: “No, by Allah, we have no book that we read except the Book of Allah and what is in this sheet.” He unfolded it, and in it were the ages of camels and matters concerning wounds. It also contained: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Madinah is a sanctuary between ‘Ayr and Thawr. Whoever introduces an unlawful innovation or offense therein, or shelters one who does so, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will accept from him neither obligatory nor voluntary deed, neither repentance nor ransom. The covenant of the Muslims is one; the least of them may grant it. Whoever violates the covenant of a Muslim, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will accept from him neither obligatory nor voluntary deed, neither repentance nor ransom. Whoever claims affiliation to someone other than his father, or attaches himself to patrons other than his rightful patrons, upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people. On the Day of Resurrection Allah will accept from him neither obligatory nor voluntary deed, neither repentance nor ransom.” “The covenant of the Muslims” means their pledge and security. “Akhfarahu” means that he broke his covenant. “Sarf” means repentance; it has also been said to mean a stratagem. “ ‘Adl” means ransom.
en.narrator: Yazid bin Sharik bin Tariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

original_columns.sunnah.com_arabic_full_text: وعن يزيد بن شريك بن طارق قال: رأيت عليا رضي الله عنه على المنبر يخطب، فسمعته يقول: لا والله ما عندنا من كتاب نقرؤه إلا كتاب الله، وما في هذه الصحيفة، فنشرها فإذا فيها أسنان الإبل، وأشياء من الجراحات، وفيها: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : "المدينة حرم ما بين عير إلى ثور، فمن أحدث فيها حدثاً، أو آوى محدثاً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ذمة المسلمين واحدة، يسعى بها أدناهم، فمن أخفر مسلماً، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً، ومن ادعى إلى غير أبيه، أو انتمى إلى غير مواليه، فعليه لعنة الله والملائكة والناس أجمعين، لا يقبل الله منه يوم القيامة صرفاً ولا عدلاً" "ذِمَّةُ المُسْلِمِينَ"أيْ: عَهْدُهُمْ وأمانتُهُم."وَأخْفَرَهُ": نَقَضَ عَهْدَهُ."والصَّرفُ": التَّوْبَةُ، وَقِيلَ: الحِيلَةُ."وَالْعَدْلُ": الفِدَاءُ.
original_columns.turkish_full_text: Sa’d b. Ebû Vakkâs’tan (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber şöyle buyurmuştur: Kim babası olmadığını bildiği hâlde, babasından başka birine “babamdır” diye neseb iddia ederse, cennet ona haramdır.
original_columns.english_full_text: Yazid bin Sharik bin Tariq (May Allah be pleased with him) said: I saw 'Ali (May Allah be pleased with him) giving a Khutbah (sermon) from the pulpit and I heard him saying: "By Allah, we have no book to read except Allah's Book and what is written in this scroll. He unrolled the scroll which showed a list of what sort of camels to be given as blood-money, and other legal matters relating to killing game in the sanctuary of Makkah and the expiation thereof. In it was also written: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: 'Al-Madinah is a sanctuary from 'Air to Thaur (mountains). He who innovates in this territory new ideas in Islam, commits a sin therein, or shelters the innovators, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. The asylum (pledge of protection) granted by any Muslim (even of the) lowest status is to be honoured and respected by all other Muslims, and whoever betrays a Muslim in this respect (by violating the pledge) will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels, and all the people; and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever attributes his fatherhood to someone other than his (real) father, and takes someone else as his master other than his (real) master without his permission, will incur the Curse of Allah, the angels and all the people, and Allah will accept from him neither repentance nor a ransom on the Day of Resurrection.".

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: “ليس من رجل ادعى لغير أبيه وهو يعلمه إلا كفر، ومن ادعى ما ليس له، فليس منا، وليتبوأ مقعده من النار، ومن دعا رجلاً بالكفر، أو قال: عدو الله، وليس كذلك إلا حار عليه”

tr.diyanet_full_text: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) rivayet edildiğine göre Peygamber şöyle buyurmuştur: Babalarınızdan yüz çevirmeyin. Kim babasından yüz çevirirse, bu bir nankörlüktür.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ebû Zer radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre o, Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’in şöyle buyurduğunu işitmiştir: “Bir kimse, bilerek kendisini babasından başkasına nispet ederse, mutlaka küfür etmiş olur. Kim kendisine ait olmayan bir şeyi iddia ederse bizden değildir; cehennemdeki yerine hazırlansın. Kim bir adama küfür isnadında bulunur veya ‘Allah’ın düşmanı’ der de o kimse öyle değilse, bu söz kendisine döner.”

en.sunnah_full_text: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "A person who attributes his fatherhood to anyone other than his real father, knowing that he is not his father, commits an act of disbelief. And he who makes a claim of anything which in fact does not belong to him, is none of us. He should make his abode in Hell, and he who labels anyone as disbeliever or calls him the enemy of Allah and he is in fact not so, his charge will revert to him.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Abu Dharr (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that he heard the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) say: “No man claims affiliation to someone other than his father, while knowing it, except that he has committed disbelief. Whoever claims what is not his is not of us, and let him take his seat in the Fire. Whoever calls a man a disbeliever, or says, ‘Enemy of Allah,’ while he is not such, it returns upon him.”
en.narrator: Abu Dharr (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:

ar.sunnah_full_text: وعن أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن الله تعالى يغار، وغيرة الله أن يأتي المرء ما حرم الله عليه"

tr.diyanet_full_text: Yezîd b. Şerîk b. Târık’tan rivayet edildiğine göre o, şöyle demiştir: Hz. Ali’yi (ra) minber üzerinde hitap ederken gördüm ve şöyle buyurduğunu işittim: Hayır, vallahi, bizim yanımızda Allah’ın kitabı ile bu sahifede yazılı olandan başka yoktur, dedi ve sahifeyi açtı. İçinde (zekâta tabi) develerin yaşları, yaralamalar karşısında ödenmesi gereken diyet bedelleri bildirilmekteydi. Yine o sahifede Resûlullah’ın şöyle buyurduğu yazılı idi: “Medine’nin Ayr Dağı ile Sevr Dağı arası haremdir (güvenli bölgedir). Her kim Medine’nin bu bölgesi içinde (Allah’ın emrine ve Peygamber’in sünnetine) aykırı bir şey yapar veya böyle bidatı (dini, hukuki mesnedi olmayan bir şey) ihdas edeni himaye ederse Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün halkın lâneti onların üzerine olsun. Kıyamet gününde Allah, o kimsenin tövbe ve fidyesini kabul etmez. Bütün Müslümanlar eşit düzeyde güvence verme hakkına sahiptir. Sıradan bir Müslümanın verdiği güvence dahi muteberdir. Kim bir Müslümanın verdiği güvenceyi çiğnerse, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün halkın lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah kıyamet gününde onun tövbe ve fidyesini kabul etmez. Kim de babasından veya efendisinden başkasına mensubiyet iddiasında bulunursa, Allah’ın, meleklerin ve bütün halkın lâneti onun üzerine olsun. Allah Teâlâ kıyamet gününde onun tövbesini de fidyesini de kabul etmez.”
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Ebû Hüreyre radıyallahu anh’tan rivayet edildiğine göre Nebî sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem şöyle buyurdu: “Şüphesiz Allah Teâlâ gayret sahibidir. Allah’ın gayreti, kulun Allah’ın kendisine haram kıldığı şeyi yapmasıdır.”

en.sunnah_full_text: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Allah, the Exalted, becomes angry, and His Anger is provoked when a person does what Allah has declared unlawful.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Indeed, Allah the Exalted has protective jealousy, and the protective jealousy of Allah is that a person should commit what Allah has forbidden him.”
en.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

Kendisine ait olmayan bir hakkı sahiplenmeye kalkan kimse bizden değildir ve o, cehennemdeki yerine hazırlansın. en.sunnah_full_text: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who takes an oath and involuntarily says: 'By Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza' should at once affirm: 'La ilaha illallah (there is no true god except Allah)', and he who says to his companion: 'Come let's gamble' should make expiation by giving something in charity.".
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: “Whoever swears and says in his oath, ‘By al-Lat and al-‘Uzza,’ let him say: ‘There is no god but Allah.’ And whoever says to his companion, ‘Come, let me gamble with you,’ let him give charity.”
en.narrator: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:

ar.sunnah_full_text: عن النواس بن سمعان رضي الله عنه قال: ذكر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الدجال ذات غداة، فخفض فيه، ورفع حتى ظنناه في طائفة النخل. فلما رحنا إليه، عرف ذلك فينا، فقال: "ما شأنكم؟” قلنا: يا رسول الله ذكرت الدجال الغداة، فخفضت فيه حتى ظنناه في طائفة النخل فقال: "غير الدجال أخوفنى عليكم؛ إن يخرج وأنا فيكم، فأنا حجيجه دونكم؛ وإن يخرج ولست فيكم، فامرؤ حجيج نفسه، والله خليفتي على كل مسلم، إنه شاب قطط، عينه طافية، كأني أشبهه بعبد العزى بن قطن، فمن أدركه منكم فليقرأ عليه فواتح سورة الكهف، إنه خارج خلة بين الشام والعراق، فعاث يمينا وعاث شمالاً، يا عباد الله فاثبتوا” قلنا: يا رسول الله وما لبثه في الأرض؟ قال: "أربعون يوماً: يوم كسنة، ويوم كشهر، ويوم كجمعة، وسائر أيامه كأيامكم" قلنا : يا رسول الله ، فذلك اليوم الذي كسنة أتكفينا فيه صلاة يوم؟ قال: لا، اقدروا له قدره” فقلنا: يا رسول الله وما إسراعه في الأرض؟ قال: "كالغيث استدبرته الريح، فيأتي على القوم، فيدعوهم، فيؤمنون به، ويستجيبون له فيأمر السماء فتمطر، والأرض فتنبت، فتروح عليهم سارحتهم، أطول ما كانت ذرى، وأسبغه ضروعاً، وأمده خواصر، ثم يأتي القوم فيدعوهم، فيردون عليه قوله، فيصرف عنهم، فيصبحون ممحلين ليس بأيديهم شيء من أموالهم، ويمر بالخربة فيقول لها: أخرجي كنوزك، فتتبعه كنوزها كيعاسيب النحل، ثم يدعو رجلاً ممتلئاً شبابا فيضربه بالسيف، فيقطعه جزلتين رمية الغرض، ثم يدعوه، فيقبل، ويتهلل وجهه يضحك، فبينما هو كذلك إذ بعث الله تعالى المسيح ابن مريم،صلى الله عليه وسلم ، فينزل عند المنارة البيضاء شرقي دمشق بين مهرودتين، واضعاً كفيه على أجنحة ملكين، إذا طأطأ رأسه، قطر، وإذا رفعه تحدر منه جمان كاللؤلؤ، فلا يحل لكافر يجد نفسه إلا مات، ونفسه ينتهي إلى حيث ينتهي طرفه، فيطلبه حتى يدركه بباب لد فيقتله، ثم يأتي عيسى ، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، قوم قد عصمهم الله منه، فيمسح عن وجوههم، ويحدثهم بدرجاتهم في الجنة، فبينما هو كذلك إذ أوحى الله تعالى إلى عيسى صلى الله عليه وسلم إني قد أخرجت عباداً لي لا يدان لأحد بقتالهم، فحرز عبادي إلى الطور، ويبعث الله يأجوج ومأجوج وهم من كل حدب ينسلون، فيمر أوائلهم على بحيرة طبرية فيشربون ما فيها، ويمر آخرهم فيقول: لقد كان بهذه مرة ماء، ويحصر نبي الله عيسى، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وأصحابه حتى يكون رأس الثور لأحدهم خيراً من مائة دينار لأحدكم اليوم، فيرغب نبي الله عيسى، صلى الله عليه وسلم وأصحابه، رضي الله عنهم، إلى الله تعالى، فيرسل الله تعالى عليهم النغف في رقابهم، فيصبحون فرسى كموت نفس واحدة ثم يهبط نبي الله عيسى، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وأصحابه رضي الله عنهم، إلى الله تعالى، فيرسل الله تعالى عليهم النغف في رقابهم فيصبحون فرسى كموت نفس واحدة ثم يهبط نبي الله عيسى، صلى الله عليه وسلم ، وأصحابه رضي الله عنهم، إلى الأرض، فلا يجدون في الأرض موضع شبر إلا ملأه زهمهم ونتنهم، فيرغب، نبي الله عيسىصلى الله عليه وسلم ، وأصحابه رضي الله عنهم إلى الله تعالى، فيرسل الله تعالى طيراً كأعناق البخت، فتحملهم، فتطرحهم حيث شاء الله، ثم يرسل الله عز وجل مطراً لا يكن منه بيت مدر ولا وبر، فيغسل الأرض حتى يتركها كالزلقة، ثم يقال للأرض: أنبتي ثمرتك، وردي بركتك، فيومئذ تأكل العصابة من الرمانة، ويستظلون بقحفها، ويبارك في الرسل حتى إن اللقحة من الإبل لتكفي الفئام من الناس، واللقحة من البقر لتكفي القبيلة من الناس، واللقحة من الغنم لتكفي الفخذ من الناس، فبينما هم كذلك إذ بعث الله تعالى ريحاً طيبة، فتأخذهم تحت آباطهم، فتقبض روح كل مؤمن وكل مسلم؛ ويبقى شرار الناس يتهارجون فيها تهارج الحمر فعليهم تقوم الساعة" قوله: «خلة بين الشام والعراق» : أي طريقا بينهما. وقوله: «عاث» بالعين المهملة والثاء المثلثة، والعيث: أشد الفساد. «والذرى» : بضم الذال المعجمة وهو أعالي الأسنمة وهو جمع ذروة بضم الذال وكسرها « واليعاسيب» : ذكور النحل. «وجزلتين» : أي قطعتين، «والغرض» : الهدف الذي يرمى إليه بالنشاب، أي: يرميه رمية كرمية النشاب إلى الهدف. «والمهرودة» بالدال المهملة والمعجمة، وهي: الثوب المصبوغ. قوله: «لا يدان» : أي لا طاقة. «والنغف» : دود. «وفرسى» : جمع فريس، وهو القتيل. و «الزلقة» : بفتح الزاي واللام وبالقاف، ... وروي: الزلفة بضم الزاي وإسكان اللام وبالفاء وهي المرآة. ... «والعصابة» : الجماعة. «والرسل» بكسر الراء: اللبن. «واللقحة» : اللبون. «والفئام» بكسر الفاء وبعدها همزة ممدودة: الجماعة. ... «والفخذ» من الناس: دون القبيلة.

tr.diyanet_full_text: Ebû Hüreyre’den (ra) nakledildiğine göre Hz. Peygamber şöyle buyurmuştur: Allah Teâlâ da, kıskanır (gücenir). Allah’ın kıskanması (gücenmesi), kişinin Allah’ın haram kıldığı şeylere yaklaşması (dolayısıyla)dır.
tr.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Nevvâs b. Sem‘ân radıyallahu anh şöyle dedi: Resûlullah sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem bir sabah Deccâl’i anlattı; onun hakkında bazen sesini alçalttı, bazen yükseltti. Öyle ki biz onun hurmalıkların bir tarafında olduğunu sandık. Akşam ona geldiğimizde, üzerimizdeki hâli fark etti ve “Ne hâliniz var?” buyurdu. “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, sabah Deccâl’i anlattın; onun hakkında sesini alçaltıp yükselttin, hatta biz onun hurmalıkların bir tarafında olduğunu sandık.” dedik. Şöyle buyurdu: “Sizin hakkınızda beni Deccâl’den başka şeyler daha çok korkutmaktadır. Eğer o ben sizin aranızdayken çıkarsa, sizin adınıza onunla ben mücadele ederim. Eğer ben aranızda değilken çıkarsa, herkes kendi adına onunla mücadele edecektir. Allah her Müslüman üzerine benim vekilimdir. O kıvırcık saçlı genç bir adamdır; gözü dışa doğru kabarıktır. Onu sanki Abdüluzzâ b. Katan’a benzetiyorum. Sizden kim ona yetişirse, üzerine Kehf sûresinin baş tarafını okusun. O, Şam ile Irak arasındaki bir yoldan çıkacak; sağa ve sola fesat saçacaktır. Ey Allah’ın kulları, sebat edin!” Biz, “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, yeryüzünde kalışı ne kadar olacaktır?” dedik. “Kırk gün: Bir günü bir yıl gibi, bir günü bir ay gibi, bir günü bir hafta gibi, diğer günleri ise sizin günleriniz gibi.” buyurdu. “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, bir yıl gibi olan o günde bize bir günlük namaz yeter mi?” dedik. “Hayır, onun için vaktini takdir ediniz.” buyurdu. “Ey Allah’ın Resûlü, yeryüzündeki hızı nasıl olacaktır?” dedik. “Rüzgârın önüne kattığı yağmur gibi. Bir topluluğa gelir, onları davet eder; ona iman eder ve icabet ederler. Göğe emreder, yağmur yağdırır; yere emreder, bitirir. Hayvanları akşam onlara döndüğünde hörgüçleri en uzun, memeleri en dolgun ve böğürleri en geniş hâlde olur. Sonra başka bir topluluğa gelir, onları davet eder; onlar sözünü reddederler. O da onlardan ayrılır; sabahı kuraklık içinde geçirirler ve mallarından ellerinde hiçbir şey kalmaz. Harabeye uğrar ve ona, ‘Hazinelerini çıkar.’ der; hazineleri de arı erkekleri gibi onun ardından gider. Sonra gençliği yerinde bir adamı çağırır; onu kılıçla vurup hedefe atılan ok gibi iki parçaya ayırır. Sonra onu çağırır; adam yüzü parlayarak ve gülerek gelir. O bu hâlde iken Allah Teâlâ Meryem oğlu Mesih İsa’yı gönderir. O, Şam’ın doğusundaki beyaz minarenin yanında, iki boyalı elbise içinde, ellerini iki meleğin kanatları üzerine koymuş hâlde iner. Başını eğdiğinde su damlar; kaldırdığında ondan inci taneleri gibi damlalar süzülür. Onun nefesini bulan hiçbir kâfirin yaşaması helâl olmaz; nefesi de gözünün gördüğü yere kadar ulaşır. Deccâl’i arar ve nihayet Ludd kapısında ona yetişip onu öldürür. Sonra İsa sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem, Allah’ın Deccâl’den koruduğu bir topluluğun yanına gelir; yüzlerini mesheder ve onlara cennetteki derecelerini bildirir. O bu hâlde iken Allah Teâlâ İsa sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem’e şöyle vahyeder: ‘Ben öyle kullarımı çıkardım ki hiç kimsenin onlarla savaşmaya gücü yetmez; kullarımı Tûr’a sığındır.’ Allah Ye’cûc ve Me’cûc’ü gönderir; onlar her tepeden akın ederler. İlkleri Taberiye gölüne uğrar ve içindeki suyu içerler; sonları oradan geçerken, ‘Bir zamanlar burada su varmış.’ der. Allah’ın Nebîsi İsa sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ve arkadaşları kuşatılır; öyle ki onlardan biri için bir öküz başı, bugün sizin yüz dinarınızdan daha hayırlı olur. Allah’ın Nebîsi İsa sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ve arkadaşları Allah Teâlâ’ya yönelip dua ederler; Allah da onların boyunlarına nagaf denilen kurtçuklar gönderir ve hepsi tek bir canın ölümü gibi ölü olarak sabahlarlar. Sonra Allah’ın Nebîsi İsa sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ve arkadaşları —Allah onlardan razı olsun— Allah Teâlâ’ya yönelirler; Allah onların boyunlarına nagaf gönderir de hepsi tek bir canın ölümü gibi ölü olarak sabahlarlar. Sonra Allah’ın Nebîsi İsa sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ve arkadaşları yeryüzüne inerler; yeryüzünde onların pisliği ve kötü kokusuyla dolmamış bir karış yer bulamazlar. Allah’ın Nebîsi İsa sallallahu aleyhi ve sellem ve arkadaşları Allah Teâlâ’ya yönelip dua ederler; Allah, deve boyunları gibi kuşlar gönderir; onları taşır ve Allah’ın dilediği yere atarlar. Sonra Allah Azze ve Celle bir yağmur gönderir; ne kerpiçten ne de kıldan hiçbir ev ondan korunamaz. Yeryüzünü yıkar ve onu kaygan ayna gibi bırakır. Sonra yeryüzüne, ‘Meyveni bitir, bereketini geri ver.’ denir. O gün bir topluluk bir tek nardan yer ve kabuğuyla gölgelenir. Süte bereket verilir; öyle ki bir deve sağmalının sütü büyük bir topluluğa, bir inek sağmalının sütü bir kabileye, bir koyun sağmalının sütü de bir insan grubuna yeter. Onlar bu hâlde iken Allah Teâlâ hoş bir rüzgâr gönderir; onları koltuk altlarından yakalar ve her müminin, her Müslümanın ruhunu alır. Geriye insanların şerlileri kalır; eşeklerin çiftleşmesi gibi alenen çiftleşirler. Kıyamet onların üzerine kopar.” “Şam ile Irak arasında bir halle” sözü, ikisi arasında bir yol demektir. “Âse” kelimesi ayın ve peltek se ile olup çok şiddetli fesat anlamındadır. “Zürâ”, hörgüçlerin yüksek yerleridir; “zirve”nin çoğuludur. “Ye‘âsîb”, erkek arılar demektir. “Cizleteyn”, iki parça demektir. “Ğarad”, ok atılan hedeftir; yani onu ok hedefe atılır gibi fırlatır. “Mehrûde”, boyanmış elbisedir. “Lâ yedân” gücü yetmez demektir. “Nagaf”, kurtçuklardır. “Fersâ”, öldürülmüş kimse anlamındaki “ferîs”in çoğuludur. “Zeleka”, zâ ve lâmın fethiyle ve kaf ile gelir; kaygan yer demektir. “Zülfe” şeklinde de rivayet edilmiştir; zâ ötreli, lâm sakin ve fe iledir; ayna demektir. “Usâbe” topluluk demektir. “Resl”, ra’nın kesresiyle süt demektir. “Lakha”, süt veren hayvan demektir. “Fiâm”, fe’nin kesresi ve ardından uzatmalı hemze ile topluluk demektir. İnsanlardan “fahiz” ise kabileden küçük topluluktur.

en.sunnah_full_text: An-Nawwas bin Sam`an (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: One morning the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made a mention of Dajjal, and he described him to be insignificant and at the same time described him so significant that we thought he was on the date-palm trees (i.e., nearby). When we went to him (the Prophet (ﷺ)) in the evening, he perceived the sign of fear on our faces. He said, "What is the matter with you?'' We said: "O Messenger of Allah, you talked about Dajjal this morning raising your voice and lowering it until we thought he was hiding in the palm-trees grove: He said: "Something other than Dajjal make worry about you. If he appears while I am with you, I will defend you against him. But if he appears after I die, then everyone of you is his own defender. Allah is the One Who remains after me to guide every Muslim. Dajjal will be a young man with very curly hair with one eye protruding (with which he cannot see). I compare (his appearance) to that of Al-`Uzza bin Qatan. He who amongst you survives to see him, should recite over him the opening Ayat of Surat Al-Kahf (i.e., Surat 18: Verses 1-8). He will appear on the way between Syria and Iraq and will spread mischief right and left. O slaves of Allah! Remain adhered to the truth.'' We asked: "O Messenger of Allah! How long will he stay on the earth?'' He said, "For forty days. One day will be like a year, one day like a month, one day like a week and the rest of the days will be like your days.'' We said: "O Messenger of Allah! Will one day's Salat (prayer) suffice for the Salat of that day which will be equal to one year?'' Thereupon he said, "No, but you must make an estimate of time and then offer Salat.'' We said: "O Messenger of Allah! How quickly will he walk upon the earth?'' Thereupon he said, "Like cloud driven by the wind (i.e., very quickly). He will come to the people and call them to his obedience and they will affirm their faith in him and respond to him. He will then give command to the sky and it will send its rain upon the earth and he will then send his command to the earth and it will grow vegetation. Then in the evening their pasturing animals will come to them with their humps very high and their udders full of milk and their flanks stretched. He will then come to another people and invite them, but they will reject him and he will leave them, in barren lands and without any goods and chattels! He would then walk through the waste land and say to it: `Bring forth your treasures', and the treasures will come out and follow him like swarms of bees. He will then call a person brimming with youth and strike him with the sword and cut him into two pieces and make these pieces lie at a distance, which is generally between the archer and his target. He will then call that young man and he will come forward, laughing, with his face gleaming out of joy; and it will be at this very time that Allah will send `Isa (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary) who will descend at the white minaret in the eastern side of Damascus, wearing two garments lightly dyed and placing his hands on the wings of two angels. When he will lower his head, there would fall drops of water from his head, and when he will raise it up, drops like pearls would scatter from it. Every disbeliever who will find his (i.e., `Isa's) smell will die and his smell will reach as far as he will be able to see. He will then search for Dajjal until he will catch hold of him at the gate of Ludd (village near Jerusalem), and will kill him. Then the people, whom Allah will have protected, will come to `Isa son of Maryam, and he will wipe their faces and will inform them of their ranks in Jannah, and it will be under such conditions that Allah will reveal to `Isa these words: `I have brought forth from amongst my slaves such people against whom none will be able to fight, so take these people safely to the mountain.' And then Allah will send Ya'juj and Ma'juj (Gog and Magog people) and they will sworn down from every slope. The first of them will pass the Lake Tabariyah (near the Dead Sea in Palestine) and drink all its water. And when the last of them will pass, he will say: `There was once water there.' Prophet `Isa (ﷺ) and his companions will then be so much hard-pressed that the head of an ox will be dearer to them than one hundred dinar, and `Isa along with his companions, will make supplication to Allah, Who will send insects which will attack their (Ya'juj and Ma'juj people) neck until they all will perish like a single person. Prophet, `¦sa and his companions will then come down and they will not find in the earth as much space as a single span which would not be filled with their corpses and their stench. Prophet `Isa and his companions will then again beseech Allah, Who will send birds whose necks will be like those of Bactrian camels, and they will carry them and throw them where Allah will desire. Then Allah will send down rain which will spare no house in the city or in the countryside. It would wash away the earth until it appears like a mirror. Then the earth will be told to bring forth its fruit and restore its blessings; and as a result of this, there will grow such a big pomegranate that a group of people will eat from it and seek shelter under its skin. Milk will be so blessed that the milk of one she-camel will suffice for a large company and the cow will give so much milk, that it will suffice for a whole tribe. The sheep will give so much milk that the whole family will be able to drink out of that, and at that time Allah will send a pleasant wind which will soothe people even under their armpits, and will take the life of every Muslim and true believer, and only the wicked will survive. They will commit adultery in public like asses and the Resurrection Day will be held.'' .
en.cpt_translation_from_arabic: Al-Nawwas ibn Sam‘an (may Allah be pleased with him) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) mentioned the Dajjal one morning, lowering and raising his voice concerning him until we thought he was in a cluster of date palms. When we went to him in the evening, he recognized that in us and said: “What is the matter with you?” We said: “O Messenger of Allah, you mentioned the Dajjal this morning and lowered and raised your voice about him until we thought he was in a cluster of date palms.” He said: “Other than the Dajjal is more fearful to me for you. If he appears while I am among you, I shall contend with him on your behalf; and if he appears while I am not among you, then each person will contend for himself, and Allah is my successor over every Muslim. He is a young man with curly hair, his eye protruding; I would liken him to ‘Abd al-‘Uzza ibn Qatan. Whoever among you reaches him should recite over him the opening verses of Surat al-Kahf. He will emerge from a road between Syria and Iraq, spreading corruption to the right and to the left. O servants of Allah, remain firm.” We said: “O Messenger of Allah, how long will he remain on earth?” He said: “Forty days: a day like a year, a day like a month, a day like a week, and the rest of his days like your days.” We said: “O Messenger of Allah, on that day which is like a year, will the prayer of one day suffice us?” He said: “No; estimate its measure for it.” We said: “O Messenger of Allah, how swift will he be upon the earth?” He said: “Like rain driven by the wind. He will come to a people and call them; they will believe in him and respond to him. He will command the sky, and it will rain; and the earth, and it will produce vegetation. Their grazing animals will return to them in the evening with the tallest humps, the fullest udders, and the broadest flanks. Then he will come to another people and call them, but they will reject his words, so he will turn away from them; they will awaken in drought, with nothing of their wealth in their hands. He will pass by a ruin and say to it, ‘Bring forth your treasures,’ and its treasures will follow him like drones of bees. Then he will call a man full of youth, strike him with the sword, and cut him into two pieces like the throw to a target. Then he will call him, and he will come forward, his face radiant and laughing. While he is like that, Allah the Exalted will send the Messiah, son of Mary (peace be upon him). He will descend at the white minaret east of Damascus, between two dyed garments, placing his palms on the wings of two angels. When he lowers his head, it drips; and when he raises it, drops like pearls fall from it. No disbeliever who finds his breath will be permitted to live, and his breath will reach as far as his sight reaches. He will pursue him until he catches him at the gate of Ludd and kills him. Then ‘Isa (peace be upon him) will come to a people whom Allah has protected from him; he will wipe their faces and tell them of their ranks in Paradise. While he is like that, Allah the Exalted will reveal to ‘Isa (peace be upon him): ‘I have brought forth servants of Mine whom no one has the power to fight; take My servants to safety at the Mount.’ Allah will send Gog and Magog, and they will stream down from every elevation. Their first ones will pass by the Lake of Tiberias and drink what is in it; their last ones will pass by and say, ‘There was once water here.’ The Prophet of Allah ‘Isa (peace be upon him) and his companions will be besieged, until the head of an ox for one of them will be better than one hundred dinars for one of you today. The Prophet of Allah ‘Isa (peace be upon him) and his companions will turn in supplication to Allah the Exalted, and Allah will send worms in their necks, so they will become dead by morning like the death of a single soul. Then the Prophet of Allah ‘Isa (peace be upon him) and his companions (may Allah be pleased with them) will turn to Allah the Exalted; Allah will send worms in their necks, and they will become dead by morning like the death of a single soul. Then the Prophet of Allah ‘Isa (peace be upon him) and his companions (may Allah be pleased with them) will descend to the earth, and they will not find on earth the space of a handspan except that it is filled with their grease and stench. The Prophet of Allah ‘Isa (peace be upon him) and his companions will turn in supplication to Allah the Exalted, and Allah will send birds like the necks of Bactrian camels; they will carry them away and cast them wherever Allah wills. Then Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will send rain from which no house of clay or hair will be protected; it will wash the earth until it leaves it like a smooth mirror. Then it will be said to the earth: ‘Bring forth your fruit and return your blessing.’ On that day a group will eat from one pomegranate and take shade under its rind. Blessing will be placed in the milk, so that the milk-camel will suffice groups of people, the milk-cow will suffice a tribe, and the milk-sheep will suffice a clan. While they are like that, Allah the Exalted will send a pleasant wind; it will take them beneath their armpits and take the soul of every believer and every Muslim. The worst of people will remain, copulating therein like donkeys; upon them the Hour will be established.” His saying, “a road between Syria and Iraq,” means a path between them. His saying, “he will spread corruption,” uses the letter ‘ayn and the three-dotted tha’; it means severe corruption. “Dhurā” are the upper parts of the humps, the plural of “dhirwah.” “Ya‘asib” are male bees. “Jizlatayn” means two pieces. “Gharad” is the target at which arrows are shot; that is, he throws him as an arrow is thrown toward a target. “Mahrudah” is a dyed garment. “La yadan” means no power. “Naghaf” are worms. “Farsa” is the plural of “faris,” one killed. “Zalaqah,” with zay and lam opened and with qaf, means a smooth surface; it has also been narrated as “zulfah,” with zay dammah, lam silent, and fa, meaning a mirror. “ ‘Usabah” means a group. “Rasl,” with kasrah on the ra, means milk. “Laqhah” is a milk-giving animal. “Fi’am,” with kasrah on the fa followed by a lengthened hamzah, means a group. “Fakhidh” among people is smaller than a tribe.
en.narrator: An-Nawwas bin Sam`an (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
